nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Matte Face Moisturizer for Oily Skin

avis.titre: Gave up and threw it away
avis.texte: I wanted to give this a chance and at least finish the container, but it just wasn't working for me. It dried sticky and sometimes would bead up and peel off if I applied sunscreen over it, no matter how long I wanted for it to absorb and dry. I would occasionally find white streaks near my hairline. I definitely won't buy this again.

As someone who avoids skincare trends, this one lives up to the hype!! I was hesitant about trying this product because my skin is sensitive & acne prone. For me, I've been amazed how great this moisturizer is. Why? 1.) doesn't leave you oily or greasy. 2.) comparable or better than high end alternative 3.) a little bit goes a long way - it's not cheap but you get your money's worth using dime size twice daily If you have combination to oily skin I would absolutely recc giving this a try, I've been satisfied
This product has amazing oil control and has been so good for my combination skin :)

avis.titre: Smooth fine lines but breaks me out
avis.texte: I have normal to oily skin so it helps with that but breaks me out bad

avis.titre: I have bought this again and again
avis.texte: Hands down, my favorite of all time. I have been using it for YEARS. It is perfect for my normal/oily skin. It feels like nothing on my face, which is my goal with moisturizers. I highly recommend this and will continue to repurchase.

avis.titre: I will buy again and have bought again and again
avis.texte: Moisturizer does great on ITS OWN! It does pill when some things are applied over it except for my Erborian tinted moisturizer. But with most foundation, it pills. I wish it kept the oil away for longer but it does the job for a couple hours.
Love this moisturizer. It doesn't feel greasy and is perfect as a base under makeup

I have really oily skin and bought this after seeing a lot of people hype this product up. It definitely is mattifying but after I put it on my skin felt a little dry. It is one of the better moisturizers ive tried.
I love the feel of this moisturizer, but it pills on my skin once dried. I stopped using it.

This "moisturizer" may work for some skin types but not mine. It completely dried out my skin so every wrinkle and fine line became prominent after I applied foundation. My face did not feel "moisturized" or "double-repaired". I'll be returning.

avis.titre: Love the brand. Didn't love this product.
avis.texte: La Roche Posay has so many holy grail products for me: The retinoid gel, double repair moisturizer, the effaclar gel cleanser, etc. etc. This product wasn't great though. I have super oily skin so I thought this could save me, but alas, it made me breakout pretty badly. Would not recommend if you have sensitive, acne-prone skin.
It pills even with nothing else applied to the skin. Feels really good going on and then it dries down nicely but doesnt feel like you put on moisturizer at all. A little tight.
No point in buying this. Doesn't get absorbed into the skin and flakes and peels off as soon as you apply make up or sunscreen on top. Pretty much a waste of money. Awful product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very nice moisturizer. I use it under my makeup for the sun protection. It is unscented but with a slight sunscreen scent. It is matte as its name suggests and is for oily or combo skin as it's not greasy. Absorbs well.

I've tried out a few face moisturizers with spf 30+ and this one is definitely one of the better ones. It doesn't take long for the moisturizer to settle and there is no residue or white cast, but it does peel when you wash it off which is a first for me. The moisturizer has a thick consistency, but is lightweight when applied. I have sensitive combination skin type and large pores if it helps anyone with same problem areas.

avis.titre: Great AM/PM moisturizer for oily skin
avis.texte: If you have oily skin, just try it. If you have combo skin — it's even great just on the t-zone for oil control. That's what I do when the weather gets colder and i need more moisture in my dry areas. It's also nice under makeup (just make sure it dries properly). Tip: tap it on instead of rubbing it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It was good but to me wasn't great. I didn't like how strong the spf smell was it literally felt like o just put sunscreen on to go to the beach or pool.

So, I have super oily skin on my t-zone & large pores from years of acne as a teenager. I've done all the research, I mean I've literally done it all it feels like. Most recently I was using The Ordinary moisturizer, which felt nice upon application but within a few hours my face looked like I fried bacon on my forehead, like seriously. I'd have to literally wipe my forehead with my arm when no one's looking to remove the shine or go blot my forehead with a tissue... I'd be so embarrassed at work sometimes having meetings in conference rooms that have awful lighting & makes me look even shinier. I could go on... I've even considered buying blotting papers to carry in my purse, assuming this is just what I deal with. But I randomly purchased this La Roche Posay moisturizer one day after hearing my coworker talk about it who has similar oily/combo skin issues. This stuff is great for oily skin!!! There is a significant difference in the oiliness of my skin in the middle of the day after using this stuff! After washing my face, I apply a generous amount while my skin is still slightly damp. I rub it in, but not all the way, instead I start patting my face at the end and just allow the rest of the product to sit on my skin and soak in. I think it really matters using enough product and applying to slightly damp skin to avoid dryness & pilling. I've been using it for a little over a week now, worn under light makeup once, & I have not experienced any pilling as other reviews have

avis.titre: I keep trying to like this product
avis.texte: I've bought twice and keep trying to like it but it's just not for me. I like that it isnt greasy and feels nice going on, but once it dries down I feel too dry. And it never plays nice with my other skincare or makeup. It likes to pill

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this moisturizer. I didn't feel like the box it came in was necessary IMO the bottle was perfectly fine with out it! I think it is a good moisturizer my face felt nice. I also enjoyed the fact that is spf. I didn't notice a scent so can't speak to that! I'd def re buy!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this moisturizer, my oily skin usually melts off my foundation but with this it stays in place. Plus it works well with my foundation not pilling!! Major plus for sun protection!!

I put this moisturizer on my face and not even an hour, I start pilling. All day long. Doesn't matter how much product you put on your face. I will NOT be repurchasing. it doesn't fully absorb. it just sits on the surface. disappointing to say the least.

avis.titre: I do have oily/combination skin, but this broke me out
avis.texte: I've used it five times now and he keeps breaking out my skin and little zits are bigger ones. I bought this because they got top ratings last year, but I really don't think it's that moisturizing either. I don't know why it's breaking out my skin.

This moisturizer sits on the top of my face and pills after about an hour. It does not make my face fee matte, but it does make it feel like the heat in my skin is being sealed in. It feels heavier than my sunscreen!
I'm very oily, i use the gel cleanser and this, problem solved.

Hey, so I overall like this product. The pilling I noticed is caused when I touch my skin, so it has been very helpful for me to get myself to not touch my face. Personally, the way I help with the pilling is to apply the moisturizer on a damp face, not a dry one. I also like to mix the product on my hands really nicely and apply it, not just put some on my hand and apply. I like to mix it up really good, and I have noticed it helps a lot to almost completely rid of the problem.
I understand its a matte moisturizer but its the equivalent of putting a matte lipstick on your face. I love this brand but this is a no for me. If you prefer dry skin this is definitely for you

I was so excited for this moisturizer because it had a good review from Wirecutter and I really needed a moisturizer that wouldn't make me look greasy! My skin is acne prone and oily on my forehead and to the left and right of my nose but very dry under my nose and on my upper lip and chin. I was happy with how this moisturizer made my skin look (matte but not dull) and that it worked well on both the dry and oily parts of my face. The unfortunate thing is that it pills a LOT, to the point that it bothers me enough that I don't want to wear it. I usually go barefaced and it still pills very badly. Putting sunscreen on top of it doesn't go very well and I imagine it would be worse with makeup. I'm really sad that it does this because I loved the product otherwise but now I have a nearly full tube of it that I can't wear which is a huge waste of money :(
I bought this product and put it on at night and woke up with red, patchy and it itchy skin and my skin feels like sandpaper, if you have sensitive skin- avoid this product:(

Its not formreally dry skin; i have normal skin, but with majorly large pores from years of extreme oiliness and sun damage. I was so sick of all koisturizers making my skin look worse, and now I have finally found the one that doesn't make me break out, and doesnt look shiny. I'm 62, for the record. Tip: don't tey to rub it in all the way or else it will pill. Just apply it, massage it a little bit, and let it soak in and dry on your skin.

please stop using the term "peels" whhen you mean it PILLS beside that, word of advice use it on damp skin that may help and if it still continues to PILL make sure you're using all your skincare ok DAMP TO WET SKIN this moisturizer is great don't let other's user error influence you
It peels very easily and makes it look like your skin is flaking off.

This product is great for a matte effect… to the point it drys out my skin somewhat. It does pill quite eaisy. I would also say it's not the best option for sensitive skin, as it made mine have red patches.
I've used this product for a few years now. Not only does my extremely sensitive skin love it, it is rated excellent by apps that rate beauty products by the healthfulness of the ingredients.
Excellent moisturizer for my combination skin. The reason for the 3 stars is that the tube is not full, it's deceiving!!
Combo skin here, in my early 40's and my skin is hard to manage nowadays. This moisturizer is IT!! The only daily moisturizer that doesn't cause me breakouts & keeps me hydrated!!
So far so good. I have oily skin and this does in fact make a difference in the amount of oil buildup (with or without makeup.) I'm hooked.
I have used La Roche moisturizer before and this product does not compare. I do not have my receipt, but would like a refund or credit.

avis.titre: No recommend it for oily skin
avis.texte: If your skin is very greasy, it isn't for you. My skin is very greasy and every time I used this moisturizer it made my skin more greasy. Also, I never felt my skin moisturizer at all.

Love the matte finish with this moisturizer. I use the toleriane wash for oily skin, then the effaclar salicylic toner, then the effaclar spot treatment and finally this moisturizer. I give it a few minutes to soak in between each step to give the products a chance to do what they're intended to do and it works great! I also make sure the moisturizer is fully dry before putting makeup and have absolutely no issues at all. It doesn't leave a film for me like I've seen in some of the other reviews and to be honest with the way it soaks in so smoothly on my skin I just don't see how it's possible. Everyone's skin is different though!

I hate not wearing foundation because my skin becomes grossly oily in a few hours. But this makes my skin look non-oily and matte with little effort. My skin doesn't feel dry, either! Would highly recommend this to anyone whose skin is oily and needs the hydration.
got this to try out and I love it! I definitely see improvement in my acne.

avis.titre: Great product! Just what I have been searching for.
avis.texte: My skin has not been reacting well to my previous moisturizers. This one has FINALLY given me the protection and feel that I've been looking for.

avis.titre: Good product for sensitive skin and acne.
avis.texte: This product soothing for my sensitive skin on face. It also helps control acne breakouts.

This moisturizer has helped me so much wotj my acne. I didnt have a set moisturizer and once i start using this one for 4 months i noticed the difference in my scars and skin. I pair this moisturizer with astrigent before to help with scarring as well and it works magic. If you are thinking about it or have trouble witj your acne like myself, i would recommend this.

avis.titre: Leaves a film on your face
avis.texte: I bought this for my husband and he said by lunch time the lotion is flaking off of him and doesn't seem like it ever really soaked in. I had this issue as well with the non oily skin version but thoughf it was a bad batch. I guess the brand isnt as good as it used to be.

avis.titre: Love the product, don't love it's not a full tube.
avis.texte: I am unsure how so many have the pilling effect. I use a drop of this after my serums, slightly smaller than a dime to moisturize my entire face and neck - patting it in. I am left with hydrated skin, smooth makeup and no oil (even after a full day).

This product is the TRUTH! I am absolutely in love. I was previously using a tula moisturizer, hiwever it didnt mesh well withcmy skin, ultimately making me greasy after so long during the day. The "matte" aspect if this cream is not too much fo cancel out the moisture, but leaves you feeling clean and smooth. I highly recommend!!!

I noticed that using it didn't really aid or trigger my acne (i use the oil cleanser from same brand) and I also just don't like it because one- its so small, 2- it leaves like a film on ur face when you're done that really bugs me.

it feels smooth when you put initially dot it on your face but it flakes like CRAZY when you rub it in. i tried cleaning my face with other products. nope, it was this moisturizer. also when you wear it all day, it ends up making my face feel like it has even more oil on it with time. i dont really feel like it mousturizes as it should so i'm definitely not repurchasing. i really wanted to like this :/
This is the worst moisturizer I've ever bought. It makes my face more oily than any other moistuzier I've tried. It starts peeling if I touch my face after I've applied it which is very annoying
Was super excited to try this but when I opened it up it felt very light. To my surprise I just took it out of the packing and was only halfway full. Total rip off of how much product you get.
This moisturizer flakes like crazy. I. Trued it with moisturizer underneath and without and it atilk flakes. It makes me oily after 1 hour too.
Once applied, it is matte but very drying. My face feels as if I used no moisturizer at all.
I usually love la Roche-Posay products but this was far from moisturizing. I have rosacea, so this didn't work well for me. Made me super dry and irritated.

Ive been using this for a bit now and its caused pilling under my makeup on several occasions. I didn't realize until now but its the cause. Im so sad because its done ok at controlling oil to a point but it doesn't play well with other products unfortunately.
It pills badly. Even after fresh exfoliated skin and daily rentinol use. Does moisturize. I'll finish it for nightime, but I wouldnt put makeup over it.
This product pills like crazy when you put makeup over it. So its best for night time use.

this moisturizer controls my sebum production like no other moisturizer!! it minimizes my oil production throughout the day, it also leaves. it can leave a slightly sticky feeling if not layered with a sunscreen, but its not a deal breaker. it's also very lightweight and a little goes a long way. I would recommend using a sebum control serum (like niacinamife, cica, or pantothenic acid) along with it for maximum oil control! the skin feeling hydrated yet matte. truly an essential for anyone with oily skin and that dislikes shine.

avis.titre: Works well alone, does not play well with other products
avis.texte: This alone leaves a nice matte finish on my very oily skin and does a decent job at keeping oil at bay. However, trying to put any type of product on top results in pilling. I use this on days where I'm not wearing any makeup.
Don't wear this under makeup or sunscreen. It pills so easily. Also dont wear this if you touch your face often.

I have bought every moisturizer for oily skin out on the market. I just so happened to come across this at Ulta beauty and thought I would try it out. I am so glad that I did this hydrates mattifies and keeps the shine down most of the day, hands-down, the best face moisturizer for extremely oily skin that I have come across thus far. thank you La Roche pose for creating this product!
First time using this and it's awesome! I love it! And I would definitely recommend it.

I wanted to like this because it sounded great under sunscreen but it pills soo bad with other products and I like how it felt alone..I used it with lrp sunscreen and it pills I used it with make up and it's pills .
It's a little sticky for me in the beginning but it doesn't last long

While this moisturizer does have a lovely, refreshing gel-cream texture, for me it did not mattify my skin nearly enough. For that, I use La Roche-Posay's Effeclar Mat moisturizer. I do still keep this one on hand for use on my neck, thus saving the more expensive Effelcar Mat for the areas where it's really needed. It does provide nice hydration and is generally lightweight, but misses the mark on really providing a matte finish. I would feel better if this product was not marketed as mattifying, but rather just a light, gel-cream hydrator for oily skin.

I have oily combination skin and a lot of products make my face extra oily. I was skeptical about this product but was recommended to me because it's matte. I would use this by itself or after I apply niacinamide serum on my face and it's very cooling and not oily at all! Had this product for more than a year now and I haven't broken out or irritated me. I don't have acne prone or sensitive skin though. Overall, really love this moisturizer.
As someone with oily skin this moisturizer does make my skin not look oily but it did give me a bunch of small white heads, started noticing when i made it my actual morning routine.

I loved the feeling of this lotion, it's very light and cooling, but I had a horrible allergic reaction, red itchy and swollen the next day, make sure you patch test even though it doesn't have a lot of ingredients🥲

Makes my makeup pill. I even let it soak in for about an hour before applying makeup. The makeup i use has the same base (water/silicone), as the moisturizer, but it still pills i am extremely disappointed.

If you have oily skin, and prone to breakouts because of it, then you need to try this! I have been using this and the matching cleanser! It took about a week and a half to notice a difference so give it some time.

I really do like this moisturizer. I have pretty sensitive combination skin that literally breaks out from everything. I got a sample from my dermatologist and fell in love. It's lightweight and absorbs nicely. I wouldn't say it makes my skin matte but does help with oil control.

avis.titre: My skin went from good to HORRIBLE
avis.texte: The first week I used this moisturizer it was amazing. I LOVED it. After the 1st week I noticed my skin peeling. I would even moisturize the dry area with out using the La Roche-Posay moisturizer and i would still be so dry from my face its been about 3 weeks now and my skin has been looking dry with red/brown spots… My skin feels like its burning and feels super itcy 24/7. I have a Dr's appointment tomorrow😔 do not buy this😣

I have combination skin that is acne prone and sensitive, so far I haven't experienced any stinging or burning or pilling. It does feel a bit tacky until it dries down. I do feel it's expensive for the product you get, cause it's about halfway filled right from the box. it's lightweight and has a watery consistency upon application. I use this with the hydrating cleanser and it seems to be a nice combination together. I don't wear make up so I can't say if it plays nice with that though. if you have dry skin this definitely won't be hydrating enough for you, I don't think this would be enough for winter in Pennsylvania.

I have sensitive skin, rosacea and Perioral Dermatitis. This is a perfect oil free dimethicone free light weight moisturizer with minimal ingredients. I was using the vanicream moisturizer but sometimes the alcohol in it bothers my skin. no problems with this moisturizer. and it doesn't irritate or worsen perioral Dermatitis!

I have kind of a combination skin and I've tried different moisturizer before and they all clogged my pore so bad and left very oily finish. This one tho, not only left my skin feeling dry and clean, but is also hydrating. I love how they have ceramide-3, niacinamide and prebiotic in this moisturizer because they help with repairing our skin, especially those that are on treatment. this product doesn't have any fragrance at all too!

avis.titre: Hate the price love the product
avis.texte: For the longest my trouble area has been my chin. My skin barrier was broken and ever since I started using this product, I have not had a breakout on my chin. I have very sensitive oily skin and I'm always afraid of trying to products on my face, but this one is a game changer!

avis.titre: i wouldn't recommend for oily skin
avis.texte: Would be better for normal or even slightly dry skin. Ive been looking for moisturizers for my oily skin and this just didnt help, my face constantly felt greasy.

i have oily skin that clogs so easily and this doesnt hurt it at all. Most oily skin moisturizers feel stuffy and clog your pores even if they do say "non comedogenic". Feels so light and pure on your face.

avis.titre: It pills. If you don't like that, move along
avis.texte: It pills. If you don't like that, move along. HOWEVER I have been prescribed azelaic acid, which pills in nearly all formulas. Since I already have pilling going on, This moisturiser is nice. It does almost all the things it claims. The 'All Day' claim is not accurate. My t zone will break through by the middle of the day. Other than that, its nice: no smell, spreads nicely, and it keeps my face matte.
It broke me out all over my forehead and nose. If you have combination skin like me this wont be hydrating enough
I have very oily skin so was excited to try but it peels on me when I wear it alone or with sunscreen

I have oily skin, i just bought this moisturizer have only used it twice. It is still early to tell if its working or not but I'm not sure how I feel about the moistureizer. It's definitely matte like it says. It almost feels drying to my face and doesn't feel hydrayting, but I'll see what happens.

I started using this product and noticed my skin had a different texture and i have been breaking out around my nose and cheeks. Never had a breakout issue prior to using. Very drying. I'm sad because i really wanted this to work.

Just tried this out I love the face wash I've been using it forever. After using this I have a weird texture on my skin that I've never had almost like I'm having an allergic reaction to it but I don't know what it could be.

I decided to try this matte moisturizer after really loving the regular Double Repair version. The first week went well, but this week my face has been very itchy and uncomfortable. In fact, I just had to cleanse it off to get some relief. I'll still buy the non-matte formula, though.

This La Roche-Posay Double Repair Matte Moisturizer supposedly provides comfortable hydration and helps reduce visible shine. And it does - then it pills. Its texture is lightweight and not too sticky. It makes my skin feel soft and look smooth. Then it pills. When I wear it with sunscreen, it pills. When I wear it with, or without, serums, it pills. Whether or not I exfoliate, it pills. When I wear it by itself, it pills. I literally just rest my cheek on my hand, and little shreds of moisturizer are left behind. There is something fundamentally wrong with the formulation of this moisturizer, which is very disappointing, because as I said, it does make my skin feel soft and look significantly less shiny. I won't continue to use it, and I don't recommend it to anyone else because of the pilling.
It was a good gel to apply for moisturizing my skin. It was a free sample so thank you for letting me try it. I don't have any oily skin problems and do appreciate it's repairing barrier.

I have very oily skin and have been on the hunt for a new skin care routine. I bought this about 5 days ago and use the face wash as well and my skin feels so much better and less oily. For those girlies who say they get a lot of peeling when they put makeup on should try water based makeup. It makes such a huge differsnce. I recommend this product and the face wash.

avis.titre: not the best of la roche
avis.texte: yes it is mattifying but it rolls off my skin. Even if i don't use make up, it just rolls off if i massage it in

Overall, I like this mositurizer. I can only use it at night because it pills up while I put on makeup. I have large pores that I'm trying to get under control, and this moisturizer is light and dewy. Absorbs quick.
Very nice bottle love it 🥰 product it self leaves my face very clean and does really help regulate oil would recommend

I tried this because I read positive reviews. I tried it for two days, day & night. When using alone I didnt have an issue with it. However, when I used it before applying sunscreen/primer, it pilled on my chin, on my temples & in between my eyebrows. Later on I washed my face & tried it again before makeup. I let it dry before adding other products & then when i started with foundation, it pilled bad again in the same areas as last time. I had to wipe it off because it was making my makeup look terrible. I am not sure if I did something wrong, but I am going to return it.
Loved it. Wished the sample was a little bottle instead of a tiny packet.

I recently just bought this moisturizer because my main concern is my oily skin. I have been having breakouts but the cream I put on at night prescribed to me by my dermatologist causes dry skin. I stopped using moisturizer during the day because my face was so oily afterwards (more than usual) but the downside was my face was beyond dry. I have only used this moisturizer for a few days but I love it! I go to school for about 8 hours and I barely have to wipe the oil off my face. My face still has oil but it is natural looking rather than the drenched layer I usually have to my skin. I love the feel of this moisturizer as well and will continue to use this!

MY SKIN IS MATTE!!! I have such oily skin and nothing has ever worked as good as this moisturizer. I use a hydrating moisturizer around my mouth because it is super matte and i have combo skin. I'm a bartender and when i get off work, my skin is still beauitful!! The other reviews probably didn't play around with it but i am obsessed! 😍

I tried using this product for as long as I could, but I keep breaking out in areas I used to never break out in. It also leaves my face feeling very dry, and after some time, it peels. I read there is a purging phase when using La Roshe-Posay, but I don't think I will continue using this product since it's making me break out a lot unlike other oil free products I have used before.

avis.titre: Love this moisturizer for my combination skin
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple of weeks now, and my face loves it. I have combination skin that's extremely oily in my T-zone, but I can put this lotion all over my face and don't end up with breakouts. My skin feels smooth and moisturized without feeling like there's a layer of product on top of it. I highly recommend this product.

Well I wanted to love it but unfortunately I didn't. I absolutely love La Roche Posay products but this wasn't the best. It seems to peel really bad even when thin layers are applied. I'm not sure if it was just my skin but I had major dryness after using for multiple days in a row. I still use it on occasion in my t-zone but never daily.

So I want to start this off by saying I'm not saying anything bad about this product. In relatively new to having a full on skincare routine, I have oily/combination skin and my t like many other people is the most oily part of my face. I tried this product out and it's true to the jams. It does have a matte finish. And it does last. The problem is after like an hour or so my face does start getting oily again and I have to keep wiping it. Not sure if it's how I apply it, I tried damp and dry skin. I also put dots on different places of my face. To summarize my face stays matte for like a good hour, or so then it starts getting oily again.

I'm 63 yrs old. I have rosacea so my skin is very sensitive. Many things cause me to break out.. this is the 1st moisturizer I have ever used that doesn't cause any bad reactions. My skin feels soft and it really has improved my skin barrier. No greasy feel or look.

I love this moisturizer. I have incredibly oily skin so it doesnt really help me there tbh but ive been using it almost a year and my skin has cleared up so much, i rarely get pimples. Pretty much all my scars have gone away. Super hydrating!

I was really looking forward to using this product because of how great the face wash has been but was let down. This made my face break out in places I have never had breakouts, made my face oily, and after applying would leave my hands feeling tacky.
When i tried this it was good but after i few hours, it starts to peel. It also doesnt mattify, my face remains oily
So far so good. Its been less than a month my skin doesnt seem to react badly so that's good
